selection: First 10 upstream EDD test paper IDs encountered in original archive order; sorted categories and pairs; up to first 5 labelled positives and 15 labelled negatives per paper. Frozen before inference. Case-control convenience subset; not prevalence representative.
scope: Extracted real-paper image pair screening only; no chemical or whole-paper accuracy claim. IDs are upstream paper identifiers, not DOI verification. No synthetic edits.

metrics.note: Metrics describe only these frozen cases. Unknown labels and abstentions are reported separately; no unlabelled paper regions enter the denominator.

limitations: Pair-level suspicion only; no pixel-localization accuracy or misconduct judgment.
External labels can contain omissions; no new expert adjudication.
Convenience stratified sample, not whole-paper or organic chemistry performance.
Exact-only types without a match abstain; unreadable/missing images never become negatives.
Do not tune thresholds on these results and continue calling this an untouched holdout.
